cause_quote: The team-mode feature added `return grouped;` inside the main-session row filter, keeping Home in the list even though the agent header already linked to the same session.
user_saw: In Show all agents mode, an agent’s Home appeared both as the header’s destination and as a session row, while session identity icons crowded the status indicators on the right.
summary: The fix makes the agent header the sole Home entry, places session identity icons 8 px before their titles, and keeps Home’s child conversations and retry controls reachable.
reasoning: I checked the team-mode introducing diff and confirmed that the header already targeted `card.mainKey`, the row filter retained that session, and the renderer placed identity icons in the trailing slot. The intervening #151401 fix removed a chip-mode exception while preserving the team-mode Home row.
